content: उपनाहः .²1 A bundle; देव्नां भाग उपनाहः <ls>Av. 9. 4. 5</ls>. .²2 An unguent applied to a wound or sore, a plaster, poultice; शोफयोरुपनाहं कुर्यात् <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²3 The tie of a lute, a peg to which the strings of a lyre are attached and by which they are tightened. .²4 Inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye.
